# Aurora Consulting Group LLC

> > Aurora Consulting Group LLC is an outsourced accounting, tax, and advisory firm founded in 2011 in Visalia, California by Sandra L. Koch. Serving entrepreneurs and business owners across Tulare, Kings, Fresno, and Kern Counties and Central California from Chico to San Diego, Aurora specializes in real estate investors, real estate brokers, contractors, B2B service providers, and multi-state/multi-entity businesses, alongside professionals, technology companies, and nonprofits. Its signature 'Team of 3' model pairs a Client Service Manager, Client Controller, and Client CFO — delivering three professionals' expertise for less than the cost of one full-time hire, backed by Enrolled Agents with IRS representation authority and fixed monthly pricing with no annual contracts.
